description: Defines the CryptoAsync class and its callback interface for asynchronous cryptographic operations within the Android media framework, including decryption handling, callback mechanisms, and thread management.

classes.name: CryptoAsync
classes.description: Handles asynchronous decryption operations, manages callbacks, and thread states for media decryption.

classes.name: CryptoAsyncCallback
classes.description: Interface for callback methods to handle decryption completion and errors.

methods.name: CryptoAsync
methods.description: Constructor initializing with a weak pointer to BufferChannelBase.

methods.name: setCallback
methods.description: Sets the callback handler for decryption events.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Initiates decryption of a message buffer.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops processing and clears buffers, used for flush or error recovery.

methods.name: decryptAndQueue
methods.description: Performs decryption and queues the buffer.

methods.name: attachEncryptedBufferAndQueue
methods.description: Attaches and queues encrypted buffer after decryption.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming messages for the looper.
